Done-when drift · 2026-11-27T09:59Z
- ADR-0160's seventh amendment merged 2026-11-27T09:52Z (PR #37877, merge commit 29e0c4bf5f; card C0a #37854 of topic #37853). It retires `ask_ai`, drops the pin, and moves the in-app read from a first-turn pre-read to a read on demand.
- This epic's `## Done when` still names an `ask_ai` action and a first answer after a pre-read, so it no longer matches the ADR. This seat does not own the epic and leaves the body to its owner. The wording that matches the amended ADR (its Implementation split) is:

> On a record page, in an edition with the in-app assistant, a new conversation opened from the shell's 「问 AI」 button is about that record, with no `ask_ai` action and no pin. A first question that refers to the record needs no tool call beyond one context read (`get_record` where the object has no pack) and draws no question back about which record is meant; a question that does not refer to the record reads no context. The focus survives navigation; the same context is served by `get_record_context` over MCP on the open edition; the open edition shows no AI button.

- The child rows 6 and 9 still say `ask_ai` and "pre-reads … on the first turn". ADR-0160 rows 6 and 9 carry the amended wording if the owner wants to mirror it.
